This is how I installed Office 2010 w/ SP2 for Mint Linux (fixing many exploits, though most wouldn't work anyway... still...) (SP2 bringing Office 2010 to version to 14.0.7015.1000)

Regarding POL, yes. The way it works is that when you picked "MS Office" to install, it created that application its own WINE prefix -- essentially its own virtual drive -- in which to run. So everything specific to MS Office is installed in this prefix and typically exists nowhere else. Exceptions can include system fonts or things like that which POL might install in the "default" prefix, but I don't think .NET would fall into that.
